review_description: Very impressed with the personal service and communication provided from the starting quote right through to the job completion. I would be pleased to recommend this supplier to all concerned. Dylan and your team thank you.

We installed an 11.8 Kw solar system with a 32KwH battery through JC Energy and are extremely happy with everything.  We received three quotes and we found their quote suited us best.  I believe their panel layout and design was the best option for our house and they also recommended the best sized battery.  One other company recommended a much bigger battery that we would rarely fill in winter and the other company recommended a smaller battery that would mean we would be having multiple charge and discharge cycles per day, thus shorten the battery life .  I can confirm that the amount of energy produced by the panels and amount that we have been able to export back to the grid has been slightly more than JC Energy estimated in their detailed quote.  While this is only based on the first two weeks of use, we have had a number of extremely cloudy days during this period.  So unlike one of the other companies that provided a quote, they don't appear to have over promised and under delivered on the performance of the system.As for the installation team they were a great group and the whole installation was extremely neat and tidy.Overall the whole team from Mikayla in the office who I spoke to several times, Jay who came out , designed the system and provided the quote, through to Josh and the installation team, we are very pleased with their work and the system they recommended.Regarding price -  they were substantially cheaper than one of the other companies that quoted for the work, and extremely similar to the third company.In summary we found that JC Energy provided a very friendly and  professional service;  an accurate estimate of what we can expect from the system; good quality panels, inverter, gateway  and batteries; a very neat and tidy install; and good after sales service, all for a fair price.   I would certainly recommend them.
They were prompt and courteous withe the order and thorough when doing the installation

Dylan and Danny from JC Energy were exceptional. They made the solar installation easy from start to finish. The quality of Dylan’s work was first class. Danny contacted my energy supplier and made sure the connection process was completed promptly. I thoroughly recommend them.
This guys do quality work and answer all your questions.  Pleasant to have onsite and made sure I was informed along the way.

I wanted to upgrade from our very old solar system and inverter and replace it with a larger array and also include a battery to take advantage of the current battery rebate. First contact with the company was with Jay who visited my home to provide a quote. Jay knows his stuff and listens to your expectations, no hard sell, he provided me with a quote that I found reasonable and within my budget. Not long after I received a phone call that my system would be installed the following week. The installers arrived on time, what a great bunch of blokes, friendly and really hard workers. After the work was finished they cleaned up the area and removed all the packaging material and the old solar system. Josh explained the system and the app, it was just an easy process, everything from the rebates to grid connection was all taken care of by them. I am more than happy with JC Energy and the great Sigenergy system install, it is working fantastically. Highly recommend this company.

We had our system upgraded and batteries added by JC Energy , and are very happy with the results . We had 3 quotes , and Dylan took the time to inspect the site and giving us a detailed quote with recommendations . Installation was prompt, professional and courteous . Our meter box was a mess from previous work over the years , but Josh took the time to sort it all out and installed new switches and circuit breakers - fantastic. There was a problem with the panel installation , but they came up with a solution and sorted it out-no problem . System very neat and all mess cleaned up-thank you. I would highly recommend this company.

The recent battery rebate lead me to source installing a battery to compliment my solar already installed.  I was directed to Dylan from JC Energy.  Dylan was prompt to attend and assess my situation and make a recommendation based on that.  He was very informative and friendly to deal with and explained costs re: bills etc.  I accepted the professional proposal they presented and before long was booked in for a 6 battery install.  At the moment there was a high demand due to the rebate but JC Energy assured me all would go ahead and they did.  Josh and his crew attended and worked around us as to when the power was off for short periods.  Josh was very friendly accomodating and did a great job with the install and finished about lunch time.  When dealing with payment and bookings Mikayala was extremely helpful and also great to deal with. The unit is neat and out of the way and all things operational was explained.I would highly recommend JC Energy from start to finish if you are thinking of installing solar.RegardsChris B

We contacted these guys as part of our renovation process. All the other companies would only do a Google maps quote, but we needed a face to face quote due to the complexity of our project.Nothing short of outstanding customer service, attention to detail and when the day arrived for installation there was not one rude word, all of the team were happy and polite. Dylan and his team left the property clean and tidy, even though it is a total construction ? site still.We have already recommended Dylan to two of our mates because the work done was of such a professional standard.We want to personally thank Dylan and the team ( including the wonderful office staff) for making the whole process feel simple and efficient!We just can’t say enough good things about this team!
They handled everything, and kept me well informed by phone, and email
First quote was quick to get in communication, punctual with great customer service.

Dylan took the time to listen to what I wanted, rather than assume I was just after the best price. Our requirements were a little different to many installations and this was the third time and third address that I purchased solar panels. When we purchased this house, it already had a 4kW system installed but we wanted a bigger installation. Dylan presented the option of adding an additional 6.1 kW of panels and upgrading the inverter to a 10kW new install. They were able to install quite quickly and they arrived when they promised. Having previous experience in the whole process, I could not have been more impressed with the quality of the installation. Very impressed and very happy.

Great experience. Super knowledgeable, always available to answer questions, quality components perfectly suited to current use and planned inclusion of PHEV and additional batteries. Everything was taken care of... I didn't have to organise anything!
JC energy is fantastic, have helped when any hiccups may arise. And the system installed by them is flawless. Extremely satisfied with their services. Thanks Dylan and Danny.

JC Energy were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish! Danny was super friendly, extremely helpful and answered all of my questions promptly. The team installed our 8kw system without any issues and did a fantastic job! They were punctual, efficient, and very reliable. Highly recommend JC Energy and will use them again in the future.
Very Happy. Punctual, easy to deal with and great result.

Dylan from JC Energy was fantastic to deal with. Provided quotes in a reasonable time, then came to the property to further review and discuss options. No other installer was willing to come out in person.  Dylan clearly explained pros and cons of also having a battery but was not pushy in any way. We decided to go with a battery as wellDylan not only provided quotes but then did the install and has continued to remotely check on the system.Installation was extremely professional, the team worked very hard on a hot and windy day. No mess left behind.  Equipment is very neatly and professionally installed. Dylan ran through the system very thoroughly after installation.Then post installation Dylan has regularly checked on the system and ensures all is working perfectly.  Had a slight issue with retailer recognising feed on but JC energy were very helpful to assist.Can’t recommend Dylan and JC electrical enough, will get them to do further electrical and solar work in the future

Efficient quoting service, company got back to us in a very timely manner. Personal service was excellent. We were kept constantly updated during the process, particularly as this was a new build and we were continually sent photos of the stages of the install along the way. They worked in with the builder as well. Great professional service.
We can highly recommend JC Energy, they were all extremely helpful and efficient with the installation. Special THANK YOU to Dylan for his expertise and customer service during the process.

Dylan was thorough investigating the installation requirements whic I knew might be tricky and so I was confident his quote was accurate. The instalation went really well and I'm very happy with the workmanship.

JC Energy were easy to talk to through the quotation process. They asked lots of questions and explained their products and quote in great detail. They were prompt in responding to any further questions we raised after our initial meeting.The staff have assisted us through each step of the process, and installation day was smooth and organised. They brought a big team of punctual and polite trades, to ensure the job was completed in the most organised and efficient way. We are extremely happy with our choice in installer and the products we have purchased.
The sales person was also the installer, so all went smoothly and as discussed. All of the team were friendly and polite. They arranged connection and left a working unit by mid-afternoon.

JC energy was our choice out of the 3 quotes we received from the website their customer service was great in the lead up ensuring we have the right system for our personal needs Dylan was a great throughout from planning to install polite and professional when in the home he and the other fellas  did an excellent job on the system it looks like it was installed with care no damage to our house and no mess left behind you can tell it wasn’t just slapped on. System is working perfectly so far we are very happy with the purchase as it has completely wiped out our bills.

From the first day we had communications with JC Energy for a solar quote the process was fast and easy.Dylan came out for a face to face quote which doesn't seem to be a service a lot of companies offer anymore.He was really down to earth and friendly and very thorough and explained everything we could possibly have had any questions about. It just felt like an informative conversation not the hard sell.He provided us with 2 different quotes on the day, one for battery ready and one for a full battery system, and said we could contact him if we had any other questions about anything. They weren't pushy about getting an answer and gave us a good week before calling to touch base to see if we had any more questions or had decided if we wanted to go ahead.On making the decision to go with JC Energy and signing the contract we only had to pay a small deposit and wait just under 2 weeks for install. The install crew were very efficient, friendly and tidied up everything before they left including tasking the packaging and rubbish with them.Dylan called the afternoon of the install to make sure we knew how to use the system and the app to monitor our usage and again told us to just call him if we had any questions.A week after install he popped back out to check on everything.We couldn't have asked for anything to go better along any of the process. We loved that Dylan was a constant contact through the process and took us through every step of the way. He made the initial phone call, arranged and showed up for the face to face, designed the system, provided he quotes, is a sparky so got on the roof and installed the system and followed up with everything.Dylan gave us some great advice on using our system to its max capabilities and was a great source of info regarding energy providers and feed in tariff information.JC Energy are highly recommended by us and we can't stop checking the app to see how much energy and money we are saving with this system.Honestly the best and most consistent customer service we have seen in a very long time.Thanks to Dylan and the JC Team
They replaced my inverter with a Goodwe one, promptly and with little fuss. They were very helpful in explaining things to me.
